{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|the droid known as the "Jedi killer"|[[Jedi Killer (disambiguation)|other uses of the term]]}}
{{Nickname}}
{{Quote|I'm glad you asked. With the Jedi killer gone, the remaining Jedi in the system will begin joining the Clone Wars, yes?|[[Haque]]|<ref name="Simplicity">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310a|text=Simplicity}}</ref>}}
The "'''Jedi killer'''" was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]<ref name="What Are We, Then?">''[[What Are We, Then?]]''</ref> that attacked and killed a number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It was eventually stopped by the Jedi, although the ensuing battle leveled buildings and destroyed [[City/Legends|city]] blocks<ref name="Letters in the Sand">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lettersinsand|text=Letters in the Sand}}</ref> in [[Hedrett]],<ref name="Faded Colors">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20060202FadedColors|text=Faded Colors|int=Faded Colors}}</ref> including some of its sewers.<ref name="Stone and Steel">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050630astonesteel|text=Stone and Steel|int=Stone and Steel}}</ref>

[[Devan For'deschel]] was injured fighting it.<ref name="Marching Orders">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050727marchingorders|text=Marching Orders|int=Marching Orders}}</ref> [[Minos Fel'Kona]] thought it sounded similar to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="What Are We, Then?">''[[What Are We, Then?]]''</ref>
